description: This file handles the upgrade commit process in SuiteCRM, including backup creation, file copying, running pre- and post-install scripts, cache cleanup, module merging, and registration of the upgrade. It manages session states and states of the upgrade process with various progress checks, error handling, and logging.

classes.name: SugarMerge
classes.description: A class responsible for merging files during the upgrade process, used to perform a module-wise merge to handle customizations.

methods.name: commitMakeBackupFiles
methods.description: Creates backups of target files before upgrade.

methods.name: set_upgrade_progress
methods.description: Sets the current progress stage of the upgrade process.

methods.name: didThisStepRunBefore
methods.description: Checks if a certain step has been executed previously to prevent rerunning.

methods.name: rebuildConfigFile
methods.description: Rebuilds the main configuration file after upgrade changes.

methods.name: post_install
methods.description: Executes post-installation scripts after file copying and other processes.

methods.name: addNewSystemTabsFromUpgrade
methods.description: Adds or updates system tabs based on the upgrade package.
